newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pernod holds 95.7 pct of Spain's Larios.
newsitem.headline: Pernod holds 95.7 pct of Spain's Larios.

text.p: Drinks group Pernod Ricard said on Monday that it had become Spain's second-largest spirits company after acquiring 95.7 percent of Spanish gin maker Larios.

"Through its two subsidiaries Pracsa and Larios, Pernod Ricard generates more than 40 billion pesetas in sales in Spain, representing the second player in this key European market," Pernod Ricard said in a statement.
The board of Larios, which accounts for more than 60 percent of the company's capital, accepted a buyout offer in June from Pernod whose terms have not been disclosed.
Pernod said shares accounting for 95.7 percent of Larios had been tendered to its Pracsa subsidiary by the offer's close on June 27.
